messages.subject: Issue with qplot geom = path
parts:
On p. 19, two issues:
1) The function definition should be be before the first qplot, otherwise it can't find the function "year"

2) running

<<<
year <- function(x)as.POSIXlt(x)$year + 1900
with(economics, qplot(unemploy/pop, uempmed, geom = 'path', size = year(date)))
>>>

on my computer does not yield the plot shown on p. 20, but the one shown on p. 19, with the legend from 20. That is, line thickness in the plot does not vary, but the legend shows it varying

Not sure what could be going on.
